newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Samsung sets 17.3 trln won sales target.
newsitem.headline: Samsung sets 17.3 trln won sales target.

text.p: Samsung Electronics Co Ltd, the flagship company of South Korea's Samsung Group, said on Monday it has set this year's sales target at 17.3 trillion won.
The company's sales were 16 trillion won in 1996.
Samsung said in a statement its export target was set at 9.8 trillion won for calendar 1997, compared with 1996 shipments of 9.9 trillion won.
The firm said it wanted to sell 7.5 trillion won worth of products locally this year, against 6.1 trillion won last year.
The sales target excluded turnover of 3.4 trillion won to be generated by overseas subsidiaries and joint ventures this year. Such sales totalled 2.3 trillion won in 1996.
Samsung Electronics plans to invest 4.5 trillion won in production facilities and research and development, the statement said, without giving a comparative figure for 1996.
"More than 80 percent of the investment will be poured into future-oriented businesses, such as multi-media, display units and telecommunications manufacturing," the statement said.
